Today I tried to run TabbyAPI with ExllamaV3, however I encountered an error with the following messages.

```sh
2025-05-11 15:32:43.929 ERROR:        f"{self.generator.max_total_tokens} tokens"
2025-05-11 15:32:43.929 ERROR:           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
2025-05-11 15:32:43.929 ERROR:    AttributeError: 'Generator' object has no attribute 'max_total_tokens'
2025-05-11 15:32:43.931 ERROR:    Sent to request: Chat completion aborted. Please check the server console.
```

So I added the missing **max_total_tokens** variable to the **Generator** class and built it using a Python 3.10/CUDA 12.8/Torch 2.7.0/Ubuntu24.04 environment before installing it into TabbyAPI's environment (latest commit - within last few hours). It seems to work well now.
Seems ok, thx. Merging into dev branch in a bit
